name: CI reference pinning guard
summary: Require immutable commit or digest references when CI workflows acquire external execution.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that reconstructs bounded CI workflow edits and blocks newly introduced external action, reusable-workflow, or container references that are mutable, dynamic, or incompletely pinned.
refuses: It does not execute, validate, repair, approve, or publish a CI workflow.
It does not resolve tags, branches, action metadata, container registries, or network identities.
It does not treat comments, prompt text, or a project-authored allowlist as authorization to bypass pinning.
It does not claim support for CI providers or reference syntaxes outside its documented scanners.

entrypoints.purpose: Reconstruct bounded CI workflow edits and reject net-new external references that are not pinned to immutable identities.
